title: Automation & integrations
tagline: The reminders, expiries and hand-offs that fall through the cracks, done by software.
forWho: Anyone paying staff to copy data between tools.
youGet: Scheduled jobs (nightly expiries, weekly digests, reminders)
Webhooks from your payment, email or booking providers
Connections to the tools you already use
Logs so you can see what ran and when

example.text: A daily job expires stale estimates; a webhook records e-Transfers against the right order.
